original.description: The original default recommended parameter set on the AIND ephys pipeline repo.

no-motion-v1.1.0-r0.description: The first attempt to disable motion correction from being applied during processing.
A revision of `name-no+motion_revision-0.json` which disables motion correction native to the spike sorters. Also clamps the seeds similarly to `name-determinstic.json`.

deterministic.description: Same as the `name-original.json`, but all `seed` entries are clamped to `0` instead of `null` or some other value.

all-channels.description: Same as the `name-deterministic.json`, but all parameters are set to include any detected 'bad channels' and not exclude any channels at any step of the pipeline.

no-motion.description: The current recommendations for running without any motion correction.

original-v1.2.2.description: A new default params file added in pipeline v1.2.2.

deterministic-v1.2.2.description: Same as the `name-original_version-1+2+2.json`, but all `seed` entries are set to `0` instead of `null` or some other value.

deterministic-v1.2.4.description: Same as the `name-original_version-1+2+2.json`, but all the proportion of bad channels to not skip is raised to 1 (no skipping).

default-v1.3.3.description: The upstream v1.3.3 defaults with the DANDI overrides carried over from `name-original_version-1+2+4.json` (NWB input, HDF5 backend, no skipping on bad channels, Spyking Circus 2 seed of 0). Motion estimation uses DREDGE in 'online' batching mode with one hour chunks (`chunk_len_s` of 3600). Chunk length trades accuracy against memory, not speed. Longer chunks give a more accurate displacement estimate but use more RAM. The online keyword arguments need SpikeInterface >= 0.105.0.

default.description: The current recommended default parameter set.
